summary: Closed Phase 12 (Classify Every Suite and Enforce the Unit/Integration Boundary). Added cost_per_assertion_ms to script-inventory.sh's --size-line probe (hinted wall-clock pool / a corpus-wide command-position assertion-call count, or 'n/a'). Classified all 157 suites discovered in the DEPLOYED/merged tests/ directory -- not just core's own 139 source-store suites -- as unit or integration in a new declarative data file (116 unit, 41 integration); the scope correction was made mid-phase after the new fixture suite's first run against the deployed tree surfaced 18 unclassified suites merged in from approvals/lean/literature. Added lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh enforcing that a unit-class suite's content must not reference deploy-headless.sh/verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh, plus a coverage-gap check (every discovered suite needs a row) and a malformed-row check (integration class needs a stated reason). Rode gate 8's existing full-battery discovery for enforcement -- zero changes to gate-registry.data/verify-deploy.sh -- rather than extending an existing numbered gate function, matching the corpus's own pre-existing lint-test-harness-adoption.sh precedent; recorded as a deviation from the plan's literal phrasing. Wrote the lint's both-polarity fixture suite (8 cases/15 assertions, all green, including the live corpus itself asserted at zero violations). Both net deltas net-positive as pre-declared in the plan: NET-PROD +273 (script-inventory.sh +33, new lint +240), NET-TEST +339 (test-script-inventory.sh +49, new fixture suite +290); the new suite-classification.data (202 lines) is uncounted by either figure since it is not a *.sh file. Full redeploy + full verify-deploy.sh battery green (26/26 gates, 39 checks, 0 failures) both before and after this phase's edits. 8 of 20 plan phases remain, starting with Phase 13 (build the shared deployed-tree fixture once and lend it read-only, consuming this phase's classification to know which suites may legitimately build one).
